destination.name: Shaoxing
destination.tagline: A canal-threaded old town of writers, calligraphy and rice wine, east of Hangzhou
destination.description: Shaoxing is a canal city of stone bridges, black-awning boats and old lanes in northern Zhejiang. It is tied to writers and scholars: Lu Xun grew up here, and Wang Xizhi wrote the Orchid Pavilion Preface at a stream-side garden in 353. Its Song-dynasty gardens and bridges sit alongside the memorial site of Yu the Great at Mount Kuaiji. It is also known for its yellow rice wine.
whyVisit: Walk gardens tied to famous poets
Trace the lives of Lu Xun and Zhou Enlai

goodToKnow.title: Go by canal boat
goodToKnow.detail: Boats on the old-town waterways give a different view of the bridges and lanes than walking does.

goodToKnow.title: Easy from Hangzhou
goodToKnow.detail: Shaoxing is a short rail hop from Hangzhou, so it works as a day trip or an overnight stay.

goodToKnow.title: Sights are spread out
goodToKnow.detail: The Orchid Pavilion and Yu's Mausoleum lie outside the old town. Plan a taxi or bus for them.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are mild and clear, good for canal walks and sightseeing. Summer is hot.
